Name: VWW - HxW Buildable Winery recolor (AT)
Author: VoidWitchCult
Description:
[center][img]https://i.postimg.cc/zD09S1Rm/title2-1-mod-details.png[/img]
﻿
[size=3][b]IMPORTANT: THis just  works with the stand-alone version. NOT the All-in-One Pack. I have a different  mod for that one![/b][/size]

The fourth building in my little OURple series! Now you can enjoy the Buildable Winery  of HxW in the wondrous shades of OURple! 

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/L65Gx0zJ/title2-1-installation.png[/img]
﻿
 - Install the latest version of SMAPI and Alternative Textures.
- Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.
- Run the game using SMAPI.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/FzBk4Tg2/title2-1-campatibility.png[/img]
Generally Compatible.  AT is just kinda bad with custom buidlings for some reason and might display the retextures a bit wonky in it's menu but when you select it it will properly apply.
